svg.title: Proposal and award status path
svg.desc: Four stages. Internal approval can take several approval steps while In Review, such as department and OSP. It ends at Approved, which starts sponsor submission at Unsubmitted. Sponsor submission ends at Accepted, which starts sponsor decision at Pending. A sponsor can ask for changes before deciding, such as just-in-time information, which moves Pending to Changes Requested and then to Intent to Award, Awarded, or Declined, or back to Pending. Sponsor decision ends at Awarded, which starts the award at In Setup. A Failed attempt is resent. An Invalid or Recalled attempt returns to Unsubmitted and is signed off again. A Withdrawn proposal ends or is revised. A recalled attempt returns to Unsubmitted and is signed off again. A proposal sent back before consideration moves from Pending to Sent Back, then to Unsubmitted, and is signed off again. A sponsor can return a proposal as Not Reviewed.
svg.text: Other records, such as modifications and subawards, have their own statuses.
Rejected can come from any point before sending,
by an approval step or the PI, including from Draft
when the sponsor reports nothing in between
fix the package, sign off again
Withdrawn can also come from Intent to Award
